metadata.name: Industrial-X Designer
metadata.summary: Authoring tools for Industrial-X playbooks in Greentic Designer.
metadata.description: Design extension exposing agentic-worker tools that list Industrial-X authoring primitives, generate starter playbook JSON, and validate a playbook against the dialect schema, reference checks and the advisory-only rule.

tools.name: ix_list_authoring_catalog
tools.description: List the playbooks, sensor names, failure modes and WASM components packaged with Industrial-X.

tools.name: ix_generate_playbook
tools.description: Generate a starter Industrial-X playbook (JSON) from an objective. Placeholders only; no tags or thresholds are invented.

tools.name: ix_validate_playbook
tools.description: Validate an Industrial-X playbook JSON: JSON Schema, reference checks and the advisory-only rule.
